goal: Catalog scan and load: walk the data folder, stable ids, unreadable list and file inventory (G-2) in app/catalog.py

acceptance_criteria.text: scan(folder) walks subfolders without following symlinks, skips names starting with '.', sorts by relative path, and returns Catalog(datasets, unreadable, others); a missing folder gives an empty catalog

Kinds by lower-case extension: csv, tsv/tab, xlsx/xlsm (one Dataset per sheet), json, jsonl/ndjson, geojson; each Dataset has id = sha1(f'{path}|{sheet or ""}')[:12], row count and column list; parquet is added by a later ticket through the same kind table
Any reader exception is caught per file into Unreadable(path, reason): empty.csv -> 'empty file', broken.xlsx -> 'not a valid xlsx'; other datasets still scan and load (AC-12)
Unrecognised extensions (manual.pdf, old .xls) go to others with type, size in bytes and modified date YYYY-MM-DD; they are never parsed
load(dataset, max_rows) returns the first max_rows rows and is lru_cache(4)-wrapped; scan is lru_cache(1) by folder and tests/conftest make_client clears both caches

tests/test_catalog.py on the data_dir fixture: 8 datasets with paths, Revenue and Lookup sheets, correct row and column counts, 2 unreadable, manual.pdf in others with type pdf and size 9, .hidden.csv absent
Moves acceptance items AC-1, AC-12 forward
